text:
Yo! I'm going to start posting some 0dte plays here more often. Just so everyone is aware of my rules...


My main focus is credit spreads (0dte and swings), that's where most of MY capital is when trading. So these 0dte single leg plays are just fun money. Not trying to make a living off of it. I've already had a great year these past 4 months, so I have the free capital to have some fun now.
,
Since they are 0dte single leg plays, they move FAST. If you want to follow along, great, but don't get mad at me if they jump 10% in 20 seconds.
,
So that I don't have to waste time typing up my incredibly long entry, tp and sl for each post....here it is for every trade:
,
SL: -50% (this means that I have bought enough contracts to be OK with losing half the value. So if I get 10 contracts at 1.00 each, that means I am perfectly ok with losing $500 on this play. Plan your trade and trade YOUR plan).
TP: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, 200%, etc. I will trim most of my contracts at 20%, then fewer at each level. For example, if I get 30 contracts, I'm trimming 16 of them at 20%, 5 at 40%, 3 more at 60%, 2 more at 80%, 1 more at 100%, 1 more at 200%, etc. That's MY plan. YOU do YOURS. If you can onluy afford 1 or 2, that's ok. Close at 20% and be happy. 

I'm only going to alert SPY and QQQ.... that's what I like, so that's what I trade.
,
